propositions: T13 plan-review criterion currently triggers only on newly-forbidden actions (prohibitions) and must be widened to include newly-added obligations (contracts, invariants, schema fields, required arguments, multi-site dependencies) to close a verified coverage gap.

The deterministic pre-gate regex in det_gate_rules.py lacks additive-obligation vocabulary and causes obligation-phrased plans to be skipped before router evaluation; a second alternation branch matching obligation lexicon must be added to make the widened trigger reachable.

Historical surface-parity audits on CLI argument changes (last 40 commits, 2026-07-30 to 2026-08-21) show 70% of content-triggered candidates owe no MCP/NDJSON updates, matching the ~90%-none omitted-scope-site precedent rate; widening surface-parity to content-trigger on CLI changes is not supported by FP analysis.

Write-parameter parity across library/CLI/MCP adapters is now covered deterministically by a transport-agnostic oracle (tests/interfaces/write_parity_contract.py) as of 2026-08-18, making any LLM-based write-parity criterion redundant for the demonstrated true-positive family.

P0 import-integrity and P3 obligation-parity criteria are rejected in favor of deterministic CI checks (full importlib walk for imports; deterministic contract oracle extension for NDJSON parity) per operator ruling.
